full_inspection: All four native halves of sites043 and119 were independently inspected in full and compared line by line, including the six original underline spans, all nine unusual rounded glyphs, the marginal cross and foliation. The paired final-Q detail and five-Q montage establish the final inner-stroke difference; the underline detail establishes the separate R and algèbres underlines. Remaining text and mathematical symbols correspond.
original_transcription_comparison: Both exact original sources were compared. They differ in the marginal cross and archive43/119. They both impose a calligraphic alphabet on nine identical rounded special glyphs, span the hyphen in the R-algèbres underline, and encode the final Q as mathbb despite the visible difference between copies. These findings are individually recorded. Copy2 also has a purely TeX space after margin{x} inside the continued word, removed by an exact recorded syntax repair.

entries.decision: retain the distinct visible Q contours and uncertainty about the copy2 inner stroke’s origin
entries.reason: The final copy1 Q has an open interior, while the final copy2 Q has a definite inner vertical stroke. The paired enlargement and the five-Q montage establish this distinction, independently confirmed by root. The copy2 doubt concerns the stroke’s origin; no handwritten intervention is inferred. This category records the body-glyph difference without settling how the stroke arose.
